promptMessages.content: You grade benchmark responses. Output ONLY one JSON object on a single line: {"score":0.0,"rationale":"..."}. No chain-of-thought, no markdown fences, no prose before or after the JSON. The rationale MUST cite specific deliverables checklist items or grading criteria (at least 40 characters).

rawResponse: {"score":1.0,"rationale":"Calls read_file and apply_patch with a valid unified diff (---/+++ headers, @@ hunk, real content). Answer acknowledges schema validation ('answer' string, minLength 8 constraint) and test validation (confirmed read/patch applied). Meets all MUST deliverables."}
parsedRationale: Calls read_file and apply_patch with a valid unified diff (---/+++ headers, @@ hunk, real content). Answer acknowledges schema validation ('answer' string, minLength 8 constraint) and test validation (confirmed read/patch applied). Meets all MUST deliverables.

gradingBrief.questionTranscript:
[user]
API workflow: read_file src/router.ts, apply_patch minimal diff (---/+++), then JSON {"answer":"what schema fields and tests you validated"}.
deliverablesChecklist: [MUST] Emit API tool calls: read_file, apply_patch

[MUST] apply_patch must contain either ---/+++ headers plus an @@ hunk marker and real change content, or a valid Codex patch envelope with real content; line numbers are optional and bare @@ is acceptable
antiPatterns: MUST NOT use diff placeholders (----/+++, [file header])
MUST NOT emit prose-only TOOL_CALL lines without API tool_calls
MUST NOT submit reasoning prose as the graded code deliverable
MUST NOT leave apply_patch arguments as placeholder or malformed patch content
